article.headline: No. 20 LSU pulls away in OT to beat SMU 95-86 in California desert
article.description: — Mo Dioubate scored 28 points, Skyy Clark and Donovan Dent each had five in overtime and No. 20 LSU beat SMU 95-86 on Thursday night in the Acrisure Series.
article.linkText: No. 20 LSU pulls away in OT to beat SMU 95-86 in California desert

article.story: PALM DESERT, Calif. -- — Mo Dioubate scored 28 points, Skyy Clark and Donovan Dent each had five in overtime and No. 20 LSU beat SMU 95-86 on Thursday night in the Acrisure Series. The Tigers have started 8-0 in back-to-back seasons under Will Wade and have a chance to start a season with nine straight victories for the first time since 1999-00. SMU (6-2) trailed 77-75 after Clark’s three-point play with 3.5 seconds remaining in regulation, but Dioubate fouled Jaylin Stewart, who made two free throws to force OT. Clark hit a 3-pointer and two free throws to start the extra period and LSU stayed in front. Dioubate made 6 of 8 shots and 16 of 20 free throws, and had nine rebounds. Dent finished with 20 points — on 8-for-16 shooting — adding nine assists and three steals. Clark made four 3-pointers and scored 18 points. Oziyah Sellers had 25 points to lead the Mustangs. Rowan Brumbaugh added 18 points and a career-high 12 assists, and Jaden Toombs had 17 points and eight rebounds. Up next SMU: Hosts Stephen F. Austin on Tuesday night. LSU: Hosts Wake Forest on Tuesday night. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
